{{Youmay|the unit of measure|the [[Limb/Legends|common body part]]}}
{{Quote|Hey there, partner. Glad to see you haven't been put six feet under yet.|Tempal B'uncho to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RotW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref>}}
A '''foot''' (plural '''feet''') was a unit of measurement for length or distance. Three feet were roughly equivalent to a [[Meter/Legends|meter]].<ref name="SWK">{{Kids1997Cite|9|Who Is That Alien?|Who Is That Alien? Ugnaughts & Kowakian Monkey-Lizards}}</ref> The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]] measured his height in feet, standing six feet tall.<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>
